section_header: EFI SYSTEM — Troubleshooting for EFI Electronic Circuit with Volt/Ohmmeter
title: Troubleshooting for EFI Electronic Circuit with Volt/Ohmmeter

content.description: Circuit diagram showing battery connected through ignition switch (with Neutral Start S/W for A/T and positions for M/T), cold start injector, circuit opening relay, starter, and ECU terminals STA and E₁
Illustration showing voltmeter connection between ECU terminals STA and E₁

content.text: ① There is no voltage between ECU terminals STA and E₁. (IG S/W ST)

content.description: Decision tree starting with 'Check starter operation', branching to OK (check wiring between ECU and starter terminal 50) or BAD (check wiring between ECU terminal E₁ and body ground). OK paths lead to 'Repair or replace', BAD paths also lead to 'Repair or replace'. If OK, proceeds to check fusible link, battery, wiring and ignition switch.
Illustration showing voltmeter connection at starter terminal STA (Terminal 50)

content.text: ② Check that there is voltage at STA (50) terminal of starter. (IG S/W ST)     STD voltage: 9 - 11 V

content.description: Decision tree showing OK path leads to 'Check starter', NO path leads to 'Check wiring between ignition switch ST terminal and starter STA (50) terminal'
